# Tushar Kapoor — Applied AI Engineer

> Portfolio of Tushar Kapoor, an applied AI engineer in New Delhi building systems that reason: deep-learning pipelines, IoT telemetry platforms, and first-principles algorithmic work.

The site is a single-page portfolio at https://tusharkapoor-oop.github.io/Kapoor-portfolio/ with these sections:

- [Hello — overview](https://tusharkapoor-oop.github.io/Kapoor-portfolio/#hero): positioning, focus areas, current status.
- [About — manifesto and stats](https://tusharkapoor-oop.github.io/Kapoor-portfolio/#about): working principles and headline numbers.
- [Work — selected projects](https://tusharkapoor-oop.github.io/Kapoor-portfolio/#work): applied AI and systems projects with architecture notes.
- [Journey — experience timeline](https://tusharkapoor-oop.github.io/Kapoor-portfolio/#journey): roles, education, and milestones.
- [Toolkit — skills](https://tusharkapoor-oop.github.io/Kapoor-portfolio/#skills): languages, frameworks, and platforms used in production.
- [Awards — recognition](https://tusharkapoor-oop.github.io/Kapoor-portfolio/#awards): certifications and achievements.
- [Contact](https://tusharkapoor-oop.github.io/Kapoor-portfolio/#contact): email and social links.
